other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2023 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 1 months imprisonment.
